assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls (FAR, height, density, green ratio, setback), road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission for provided official text values and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: All submitted boundary and key-area polygons are provisional_rough geometry derived from the official announcement text (areas, four-to descriptions, road names) and calibrated to announced areas in EPSG:4548.
assumptions.impact: Boundary and key-area metrics are provisional. When official polygons arrive, land_use partition, building footprints, green/public space, road network and every derived metric must be recalculated.

assumptions.statement: The land-use partition is a concept zoning proposal derived by polygonizing the provisional site boundary; it expresses design intent (heritage park spine, industry corridors, education strip, residential edges), not approved regulatory zoning.
assumptions.impact: Design metrics (green ratio, land-use mix, building footprint) are reproducible from geometry but are not statutory controls.

assumptions.statement: Existing building stock, ownership, heritage protection lines, road redlines, rail alignments and water blue lines inside the site were not available as cleared spatial data; constraints layer is conceptual only.
assumptions.impact: Retain/renovate/demolish categories and heritage-adjacent design decisions are directional; parcel-level conclusions require official survey data.

assumptions.statement: No official investment, enterprise, employment, or tax figures for the belt were provided; all economic and operational statements in the narrative are concept-level suggestions, not commitments.
assumptions.impact: Economic metrics remain qualitative; no fabricated certainty is claimed.

assumptions.statement: AI scenarios, testing environments and operational mechanisms are concept cards for discussion and professional deepening; none is stated as approved, operating, or government-committed.
assumptions.impact: Scenario/privacy/human-review boundaries follow Generative AI Interim Measures and Barrier-Free Law baselines at article-scope level.
